text:
ben: Ran into a reproducible failure in samplekit when using JSON_MODE + function-calling + auth-retry. Logs show the tool response wrapped in extra quotes after the retry, causing jsonschema.validate to fail.

ben: Repro (simplified):
```js
await sdk.callTool({
  tool: 'get_cart',
  json_mode: true,
  input: { user_id: 'u_42' },
  retry: { onAuth: true }
});
```

rachel: Which SDK and samplekit version?

ben: js-sdk v0.15.0, samplekit@main. Sample sandbox reproducer attached to issue.

aj: Curious: is the body double-serialized on client retry, or is server returning a quoted string after a refreshed token? Logs?

ben: Log snippet:
```
INFO retry: auth refreshed, replaying request
DEBUG tool response raw: "\"{\"items\":[1,2],\"total\":2}\""
ERROR jsonschema: Unexpected token " in JSON at position 0
```

mike: We fixed an equivalent in the Python SDK by unquoting one level in normalize_tool_output on retry. JS helper currently treats all strings as opaque.

lisa: Parity + onboarding concern. New users set json_mode=true expecting structured output; this edge makes sample apps flaky.

ops-bot: ci: samplekit/smoke failed (build 8421) — https://ci.internal/redwood/8421

aj: Proposal: in retry middleware, if json_mode is enabled OR content-type header indicates application/json, attempt a single-layer unquote: if value is a string that starts and ends with a quote and JSON.parse(inner) succeeds, use parsed value. Add a feature flag guard and schema-based condition (only unwrap when schema expects object/array).

ben: Sounds good. Also update normalizeToolResponse() across SDKs to be consistent and add a note to onboarding docs.

rachel: Action items: @aj open js-sdk PR with middleware change + unit tests, @mike add a py integration asserting parity, @lisa add samplekit e2e that exercises 401->refresh->retry, I'll update docs. I'll link the issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/issues/999

aj: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/1150 — includes unwrap heuristic + feature flag + tests.

ben: Thanks. Let's get sandbox green before next bootcamp; this repeatedly trips folks. :pray:
